definitions: To become red in the face, especially as a result of heat, emotion, or illness.
To clean or empty (something, especially a toilet) by causing water to flow through it.
To force (a bird or animal) from cover.
To be level or even with something else.
examples: He flushed the toilet after use.
The dogs flushed out the pheasants.
The top of the table was flushed with the window sill.
